x.around: Although not a very large island, St. Vincent has mountainous and rugged terrain, making it difficult to get around. Private vans or taxis are your best options. Car rental is also available.

x.intro: Kingstown is the capital of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, located on the island of Saint Vincent. The city has the main port and the biggest commercial center of the islands.
